metadata.title: Spectrum of singularities, analytic torsion and Calabi--Yau degenerations
metadata.abstract: We relate the spectrum of singularities to the geometry of degenerating Calabi--Yau manifolds through holomorphic analytic torsion. We express the leading asymptotic coefficients of the analytic torsion of holomorphic differential forms in terms of Hodge-theoretic invariants of vanishing cycles. For isolated hypersurface singularities, these formulas lead to the formulation of new higher Durfee--Saito conjectures bounding Hodge-filtration dimensions by the Milnor number and Eulerian numbers. We also prove that, for isolated quasi-homogeneous singularities, the spectral measure is dominated in convex order by the corresponding Irwin--Hall distribution. Applying the torsion formulas to the BCOV invariant yields a computable obstruction to birational smooth fillings. For isolated singularities, its local contribution is expressed in terms of Hertling's spectral variance and a Bernoulli sum determined by monodromy. As applications, we rule out birational smooth fillings for projective Calabi--Yau degenerations with smooth total space and singular central fiber having only ADE or terminal Brieskorn--Pham singularities, in relative dimension at least three, extending results of Voisin.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 把 Calabi–Yau 退化的全纯解析挠率渐近系数写成消失循环的 Hodge 数据，导出 BCOV 不变量对双有理光滑填充的可计算障碍。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出指定 ADE 或 terminal Brieskorn–Pham 奇点退化的填充排除结果，并证明拟齐次奇点谱的凸序界。
analysis.limitations: 高阶 Durfee–Saito 界在文中是新猜想；填充应用依赖总空间光滑、相对维数及奇点类型限制。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 谱、复几何与奇点退化相互连接，适合相关方向联合阅读。
